title: Site deployment checklist
content:
# Site deployment checklist

## Before the visit

- ☐ Cabinet depth measured and confirmed against the server's depth plus cabling space
- ☐ Site power type confirmed (AC or DC) and the matching power supplies fitted
- ☐ Both servers fully set up on the staging bench ([[Setup guides]])
- ☐ Site temperature range checked against Dell's rated limits for this configuration

## On site

- ☐ Servers mounted, chassis grounded, both power feeds connected
- ☐ Air filter fitted, if the cabinet requires one
- ☐ iDRAC reachable from the operations jump host
- ☐ Workload network up on both 25 GbE ports
- ☐ Labels on both ends of every cable
- ☐ Photos of the cabinet front and back uploaded to the site record

## Handover

- ☐ Servers show healthy in monitoring for 24 hours
- ☐ Entry added to the [[Maintenance log]]
